facts.fact: The FASTag Annual Pass fee is Rs 3,075 for FY 2026-27, applicable from 1 April 2026 (revised from Rs 3,000)
facts.quote: National Highways Authority of India has announced the revision of the applicable fee for the FASTag Annual Pass from the current Rs. 3,000 to Rs. 3,075 for the Financial Year 2026–27 . The increased fee will be applicable from 1st April 2026 .

facts.fact: The fee was revised under the National Highways Fee (Determination of Rates and Collection) Rules, 2008
facts.quote: The revision in the fee has been carried out in accordance with the provisions of the National Highways Fee (Determination of Rates and Collection) Rules, 2008.

facts.fact: Rs 3,000 was the fee for the base year 2025-26, i.e. from launch on 15 Aug 2025 to 31 Mar 2026 (the new fee applies from 1 April 2026)
facts.quote: the user must make a payment of ₹3,000 for the base year 2025–26 through the Rajmargyatra mobile application or NHAI website.
facts.note: Derived: the period 15 Aug 2025 to 31 Mar 2026 follows from the launch date (fact 4) and the new fee from 1 April 2026 (fact 1); the IHMCL FAQ says only 'for the base year 2025-26'.

facts.fact: The FASTag Annual Pass was launched on 15 August 2025
facts.quote: Launched on 15th August 2025 , the overwhelming response to the FASTag Annual Pass underlines the greater convenience

facts.fact: The pass is valid for one year from activation or 200 crossings, whichever comes first
facts.quote: The Annual Pass is valid for one year from the date of activation or 200 transactions (crossings), whichever comes ﬁrst.

facts.fact: IHMCL's Annual Pass report states the validity as 200 transactions or 365 days
facts.quote: Validity 200 Transactions or 365 days (whichever is earlier)
facts.note: IHMCL 'One Year of Transforming Highway Travel' booklet (Oct 2026), Table 1 Policy Overview, read by OCR.

facts.fact: After 200 crossings or one year the tag reverts to a regular FASTag and the pass must be re-activated
facts.quote: it will automatically revert to a regular FASTag. To continue using the Annual Pass beneﬁts, the user will need to re-activate the Annual Pass to get 200 crossings / 1 year validity.

facts.fact: Valid only at National Highway and National Expressway fee plazas, not at State-run highways/expressways
facts.quote: It is valid only at National Highway (NH) and National Expressway (NE) fee plazas. At fee plazas on Expressways, State Highways (SH), etc. managed by State Governments or local bodies, the FASTag will operate as a regular FASTag
No. The Annual Pass is applicable only for private non-commercial Car/Jeep/Van.

facts.fact: Activated on the existing FASTag if it is properly affixed, linked to a valid vehicle registration number and not blacklisted
facts.quote: The Annual Pass can be activated on your existing FASTag, provided it meets the eligibility criteria (i.e., it is properly aIixed on the vehicle’s windshield, linked to a valid Vehicle Registration Number, not blacklisted etc).

facts.fact: The pass can be activated only on the Rajmargyatra app or the NHAI website
facts.quote: The Annual Pass can be activated only on the Rajmargyatra mobile application and NHAI website.

facts.fact: The FASTag wallet balance cannot be used to pay for the pass
facts.quote: Q14. Can I use the money in my FASTag wallet to buy the Annual Pass? No.
No. The pass is non-transferable and is valid only for the vehicle on which the FASTag is aIixed and registered.

facts.fact: At a point-based plaza each crossing counts as one (to-and-fro is two); in closed tolling one entry-exit pair counts as one
facts.quote: For point-based fee plazas: Each crossing of fee plaza counts as one crossing. A round crossing (to and fro) counts as two crossings. For Closed Tolling fee plazas: One pair of entry and exit counts as one crossing.

summary: Rs 3,075 from 1 Apr 2026 now confirmed in text by the PIB/NHAI press release of 15 Mar 2026; 200 crossings/1 year and all pass conditions confirmed in the IHMCL FAQ. Added: launch date 15 Aug 2025 (PIB) and the 365-day wording (manual, image-only booklet).
